auth.loginSubtitle: Welcome back. Your films are waiting.
auth.signupSubtitle: One account for viewers and creators alike — never any ads.
auth.checkEmail: Account created. Check your inbox and confirm your email before signing in.
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists, we've sent a link to your email. Check your spam folder too.
auth.newPasswordSubtitle: Enter a new password for your Doccys account.

errors.emailExists: An account with that email already exists.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.weakPassword: Password is too weak — use at least 6 characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

catalog.title: Independent documentaries
catalog.subtitle: Hand-picked films without a single ad break. Pay only for what you finish watching.

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.body: No pre-roll, no interruptions, no sponsored content. The catalogue is funded entirely by minute packs.

payPerMinute.title: Pay per watched minute
payPerMinute.body: Creators earn 2 kr per 100 valid minutes watched — only logged-in plays that pass anti-fraud validation count.

community.title: The conversation beneath the film
community.body: Every film has its own discussion. No algorithms in the way — just people who watched the same thing you did.

creators.title: Creators on Doccys
creators.subtitle: The independent film companies and collectives that fill the catalog.

earningsPanel.explainer: You earn {rate} on Doccys. Only logged-in viewings approved by the anti-fraud validation count — manipulation is never paid out.
earningsPanel.threshold: Paid out when the available balance reaches DKK 150.

payoutPanel.intro: Save your account details and request a payout once your balance reaches DKK 150. The transfer is made by the editorial team — the money usually arrives within a few business days.
payoutPanel.methodHint: The IBAN is your account's international number — your online bank shows it. Danish IBANs start with DK followed by 16 digits.
payoutPanel.locked: The button unlocks when your available balance reaches DKK 150.
payoutPanel.noMethod: Save your bank details before requesting a payout.
payoutPanel.pending: You already have a pending request — the editorial team will transfer the money shortly.

watch.creator: Creator
watch.discussionSubtitle: The conversation about the film continues right beneath the player.

saveButton.loginToSave: Log in to save the film

comments.title: Discussion
comments.subtitle: Share your thoughts on the film with other viewers — no spoilers without a warning, please.
comments.loggedInNote: Your comment is posted with your profile.
comments.empty: No comments yet — be the first to put the film into words.
comments.loadError: The comments could not be loaded.
comments.submitError: The comment could not be posted. Try again.
comments.likeError: The like could not be registered. Try again.
comments.gateLoginSuffix: — only viewers can comment under the film.
comments.gateWatch: The discussion opens once you have watched the film — it is for viewers only, so it stays worth reading.
comments.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? It cannot be undone.
comments.deleteError: The comment could not be deleted. Try again.
comments.pinError: Could not pin the comment — another one is already pinned. Try again.

creatorApply.loginSubtitle: Creator applications require an account — it only takes a moment to create one.
creatorApply.title: Become a Doccys creator
creatorApply.subtitle: Doccys is curated: every creator is approved by the editorial team before their films can be shown. Tell us who you are and what you make.
creatorApply.handleHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. "nordlys-film". Once approved, your profile lives at /creator/{handle}.
creatorApply.motivationHint: Why should your films be on Doccys? A few concrete sentences will do.
creatorApply.statusPendingSub: Submitted on {date}. The editorial team responds here — the status updates automatically.
creatorApply.statusApproved: Congratulations — you are an approved creator!
creatorApply.statusApprovedSub: Your profile has been created and your studio is open. You can now upload films (they only go public once the editorial team approves them).
creatorApply.statusRejected: Your application was not approved this time.
creatorApply.statusRejectedSub: Decided on {date}. You can edit the application and send it again.

errors.handleTaken: That handle is already taken — choose another.
errors.reserved: That handle is reserved — choose another.
errors.stale: The application's status has changed — reload the page.
errors.generic: Check all fields and try again.

creatorStudio.loginTitle: Log in to open the studio
creatorStudio.loginSubtitle: The studio is for approved creators only.
creatorStudio.uploadSubtitle: The film is saved as a draft and only goes public once the editorial team approves it.
creatorStudio.posterHint: Optional (jpg/png/webp, max 10 MB, at least 640×360 pixels) — shown instead of the gradient.
creatorStudio.success: Uploaded! The film is now a draft awaiting approval.
creatorStudio.creatorNote: The film is attached to your creator profile @{handle}.

errors.notMp4: Only mp4 files can be uploaded.
errors.notPoster: Only jpg, png and webp images can be used.
errors.posterProbe: The image could not be read — is it a valid image?
errors.posterTooSmall: The image is too small — at least 640×360 pixels.
errors.posterTooBig: The image is too large — max 10 MB.
errors.posterFailed: The cover image could not be uploaded — try again.
errors.probe: The file's metadata could not be read — is it a valid mp4?
errors.missingFields: Fill in the title and synopsis, choose at least one genre and pick a video file.
errors.notLoggedIn: You are no longer logged in — log in and try again.
errors.rowFailed: The film could not be created — try again.

creatorStudio.draftNote: A draft can be deleted; a published film belongs to the editorial team.
creatorStudio.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? The video is removed as well.
creatorStudio.empty: No films yet — upload your first one above.
creatorStudio.subtitlesIntro: AI generates a transcript of the film's audio in {language} and translates it into every platform language.
creatorStudio.spokenLanguageHint: The language spoken in the film — subtitles are generated from it.
creatorStudio.subtitlesWorking: Generating subtitles — this can take several minutes for long films.
creatorStudio.subtitlesError: The subtitles could not be fully generated — try again. Failed languages can be retried with the same button.

profile.loginTitle: Log in to see your profile
profile.loginSubtitle: Your email, your minute balance and your saved films wait behind login.
profile.historySubtitle: Pick up where you left off — or revisit an old favourite.
profile.historyEmpty: No films watched yet. Finish a documentary and it will appear here — only valid completions are recorded.
profile.savedEmpty: No saved films yet. Press "Save film" under a player and the film will land here.
profile.creatorSub: Apply to become a creator and get access to upload your documentaries.
profile.creatorOwnedSub: You are an approved creator — the studio is open.

meta.title: Doccys — Independent documentaries without ads
meta.description: Doccys is a minimalist, ad-free streaming service for independent documentaries. Pay only for the minutes you actually watch — the creator gets their share, you get the quiet.

paywall.loginTitle: Log in to watch the film
paywall.loginBody: Create an account or log in — and buy a minute pack when you're ready to watch.
paywall.buyTitle: Not enough minutes on your balance
paywall.buyBody: The film requires {minutes} minutes, and your balance is {balance}. Buy a pack to start playing.

minutes.heading: Minutes
minutes.purchaseSuccess: Thanks for your purchase! The minutes land on your balance as soon as the payment is confirmed.
minutes.purchaseError: The purchase could not be completed — try again.
minutes.referralUnavailable: Your referral link could not be shown right now.

affiliate.explainer: Share your link with friends. When a friend buys their first minute pack via your link, you get 250 minutes on your balance.
affiliate.reward: 250 minutes per friend who buys their first pack.

bulletinBoard.title: News from the creator
bulletinBoard.subtitle: Messages and announcements straight from the creator.
bulletinBoard.placeholder: Write a message to your viewers…
bulletinBoard.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? This cannot be undone.
bulletinBoard.empty: The creator hasn't posted anything yet.
bulletinBoard.emptyOwner: Post your first message — your viewers will see it here.
bulletinBoard.submitError: The message could not be posted. Try again.
